confirmedBgsFinding.name: Nested cwd incorrectly reported as another workspace
confirmedBgsFinding.trigger: Agent cd into same-project temporary tools directory and runs an old handoff entry.
confirmedBgsFinding.impact: Misleading error followed by unnecessary broad searches for legacy design-handoffs. These requests carry long existing context. Cannot attribute all post-draft cost to this error.
confirmedBgsFinding.boundary: Incorrect cwd and reuse of old turn entry were Agent choices. Current turn context provided the new entry. Permission restriction itself is not proven wrong.
confirmedBgsFinding.proposal: Keep root/capability checks. Report actual cwd mismatch with the required project root and recovery instruction. Align equivalent existing entry diagnostics without adding a new framework.
